lessons.culture: In Sana'a quick food means shawarma, broasted chicken, burgers and sandwiches, eaten standing at the counter or carried home. Food to take away is "سفري", and "أشتي" (I want) opens almost every order. Asking whether the meat is halal is normal and never rude.

exercises.tip: "سفري" (literally "for travel") is the word for takeaway.

lessons.culture: In Yemen the big meal is lunch, "الغدا", often eaten sitting on the floor around shared dishes such as سلتة and بنت الصحن. The host keeps urging "شِلّ زيادة" (take more), and after the meal comes sweet شاهي or قشر, a drink made from coffee husks.

challenge.title: Order a Full Yemeni Meal
challenge.instructions: You're at a Sanaani restaurant. Order a complete meal including a main dish, a drink, and a dessert. Ask for modifications. Then ask for the bill and pay.
required_elements: A Yemeni main dish (mandi, salta, fahsa, or zurbiyan)
A request phrase with a modification (without X, please)
Payment phrase (cash, card, or keep the change)
